answer.report_md:
## 画出来要什么
单面板折线图：25 个年度点、约 8 条线（1 条粗深蓝 `Baseline` + 约 7 条细浅蓝 `Alternative approaches`），无图例，靠线内文字命名；两条灰色竖向事件带并在带内写 `Great Financial Crisis`、`Covid-19 Pandemic`；y 轴起点 80（非零），刻度 80/100/120/140/160，单位行 `Material markup (indexed to 1997 = 100)` 置于顶刻度之上；x 轴每 4 年一刻度（1997…2021），轴题 `Year` 在图下；图上方是编号标题加 5 行斜体方法说明，图下方是 3 行小字注释。

## 定位一个值难在哪
以 141 为例：它是 2021 年最高的一条浅蓝线。页面只给了 `Alternative approaches` 一个标签，7 条线互相缠绕、颜色粗细一致，无法把 141 唯一定位到某条线；年份也需在 2017 与 2021 刻度间推断。相比之下 `Baseline` 1997 的 100 很好定位。

## 不确定的
浅蓝线的确切条数（约 7 条，末端重叠）；是否真有淡横向网格线；灰带覆盖的确切年份区间（约 2006–2008、2019–2021）只能目测。

heading.title: Average markups in GB have risen since 1997
heading.subtitle: Economy-wide average markup estimates. Baseline measure: Ordinary Least Square (OLS) estimation of a translog production function with materials as flexible input. Firm-level estimates are aggregated and weighted by turnover. Data from Annual Respondents Database X (ARDx) 1997-2020 and Annual Business Survey (ABS) 2021. GB only

axes.serves: all lines, baseline and alternative approaches

worked_example.why_hard: Seven near-identical light-blue lines share one label; year sits between ticks four years apart

components.evidence: two grey vertical bands labelled "Great Financial Crisis" and "Covid-19 Pandemic" inside the plot
"Alternative approaches" in light blue and "Baseline" in dark blue written next to the lines; no legend
series names are the only key and are drawn over the plot area itself
"Great Financial Crisis" and "Covid-19 Pandemic" text drawn over the plot above the grey bands
the y axis lowest tick reads 80, then 100, 120, 140, 160; no break glyph
"Material markup (indexed to 1997 = 100)" sits above the 160 tick, not alongside the axis
bare y ticks 80-160; scale given only by "Material markup (indexed to 1997 = 100)"
"(indexed to 1997 = 100)" above the y axis; all lines start at 100 in 1997
small print under plot: "Markups are calculated following our baseline approach... Data from the Annual Respondents Database X (1997-2020)"
one thick dark-blue "Baseline" line among thin light-blue alternative lines
about eight lines over 25 annual points, roughly 200 plotted points
faint horizontal rules at 100, 120, 140 across the panel; no vertical rules

new_components.name: series_bundle_single_label
new_components.evidence: about seven light-blue lines carry one shared label "Alternative approaches"; no per-line name anywhere

new_components.name: line_weight_encodes_primary_series
new_components.evidence: baseline drawn as a thick dark line, alternatives thin, so stroke weight separates the headline series

new_components.name: axis_title_below_time_axis
new_components.evidence: "Year" printed centred below the 1997-2021 tick row

spot_checks.mark: the Baseline line at 1997, the index base where all lines start
the Baseline line around 1999-2000, just below the 100 gridline
the Baseline line around 2004-2005 near its local peak below 105
the Baseline line around 2010, a second reading near 103
the Baseline line near its 2014-2015 peak just above 110
the Baseline line around 2017-2018, flat just above the 100 gridline
the Baseline line at its 2021 endpoint, rising to about 111
the highest light-blue alternative line at 2021, just above 140
a light-blue alternative line near its 2013-2014 peak below 145
the alternative approach lines at 1997, all rebased to the 100 base

answer.hardest_step_why: 141、143 只有 "Alternative approaches" 一个标签覆盖约七条同色线，无法唯一定位；年份也在四年一刻度间推断。

examples.quote: "Alternative approaches" written once in light blue beside about seven indistinguishable thin light-blue lines
examples.why: 当前流水线每条线都有独立图例项；此页需要“一族无名线共用一个标签”，键无法唯一定位。

examples.quote: Figure 5: Average markups in GB have risen since 1997 — then five italic lines, then "Material markup (indexed to 1997 = 100)" above the axis
examples.why: 标题、长方法学副标题与单位行分处三个位置，需把编号/标题/副标题/单位/位置拆成独立字段。

examples.quote: y axis ticks read 80, 100, 120, 140, 160; two grey vertical bands labelled inside the plot
examples.why: 非零起点轴加带内文字标注的事件阴影带，是现有样式维度未覆盖的组合。

examples.quote: eight lines drawn over annual points 1997 to 2021 in one panel, overlapping between 120 and 145
examples.why: 单面板约 200 个点且线条互相缠绕，超出当前密度上限，需把密度作为可控变量。

examples.quote: one thick dark-blue line versus seven thin light-blue lines, no legend box anywhere
examples.why: 颜色与线宽承载“基准 vs 替代方法族”这一属性，需进入定位键。
